description: This file implements cache manipulation routines for the MIPS architecture, specifically for flushing CPU caches on Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards as part of a bootloader or kernel loader, using LZMA compressed kernel images.

methods.name: void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Flushes and invalidates cache lines over a given memory range to ensure memory coherency during boot or loading operations.

ctags.name: flush_cache
ctags.pattern: /^void flush_cache(unsigned long start_addr, unsigned long size)$/
